title: Queue items point at session files that vanish
what: A queue item holds the owner's words verbatim and measured facts each as one dated line, and no link to a report: research and design are done when the item is taken. `relay queue add` refuses text that names a session scratchpad or /private/tmp path, saying to put the fact itself in. The 12 open items that point into a scratchpad get, through relay's queue writer, the facts they rely on in place of the link (a fact that cannot be recovered is dropped and the item says so).
why: Owner, 26 Oct: "когда ты проводишь исследование и создаешь задачу, куда ты сохраняешь отчет, в задачу ты пишешь лишь короткий кусочек информации, нужно ли это ? Или достаточно просто сохранить запрос пользователя а дизайн будет выполнен перед выполнением, что позволяет нам освободиться от неактуальных результатов исследования и сделать новое непосредственно перед выполнением", then "Согласен с рекомендованным вариантом" (owner's words plus dated facts, no report links). Measured 26 Oct: 12 of 69 open items name a scratchpad path (a /private/tmp folder cleared on reboot); this session wrote 451 report files. Build after wt/where-list merges (both rewrite queue records). IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: `grep -l scratchpad .relay/queue/*.json` lists 12 open items on 26 Oct.
pass_cases: The same grep lists none; relay queue add with a why naming /private/tmp/... is refused with the message; an item with only the owner's words and dated facts is accepted.
where: lib/relay_queue.py (add), the 12 open items naming a scratchpad path
